bifrost: springboard/src/shell/books/engine/pdf/ (reader), springboard/sdk/src/print.rs (Save as PDF, lp submission)
summary: BifrOSt has an internal PDF reader inside the Books app that loads a file, walks the page tree, extracts text, images and the outline, and reflows the result into the Books page model. Printing a PDF goes through the SDK print API. There is no app-facing PDF document, page, view, annotation, form, selection or thumbnail API.

features.apple: PDFView, PDFViewDelegate, currentPage, visiblePages, displayMode, scaling
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/books/engine/pdf/mod.rs (reflow into the Books model, not a page view)
features.note: No app-facing view. Books reflows text into its own page model, so page geometry and scaling are not Apple's
Wave 2 (theme-21, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No PDF page thumbnail generator
Loads from bytes inside Books only; no SDK call, and no PDFDocument-like object for apps

features.apple: PDFDocument read operations, page count, attributes
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/books/engine/pdf/doc.rs (xref, object scan when the xref is bad), springboard/src/shell/books/engine/pdf/obj.rs
features.note: Reader only; no attribute or metadata API for apps

features.feature: PDFPage: page tree and text extraction
features.apple: PDFPage string, attributedString, characterBounds(at:), characterIndex(at:), numberOfCharacters
features.note: Text is extracted in reading order. No per-character bounds or index lookup

features.apple: PDFPage draw(with:to:), transformContext(for:), thumbnail, display boxes, rotation
features.note: Wave 2 (theme-21, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No page rasterisation or drawing into a context. Books draws reflowed content, and JPEG 2000, CCITT and JBIG2 images are not shown

features.feature: PDFPage: page image and PDF creation
features.note: Wave 2 (theme-21, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No API to create a PDF page from an image or to serialize a page

features.apple: PDFAnnotation, PDFPage addAnnotation(_:), removeAnnotation(_:), annotation(at:), displaysAnnotations, ink and stamp types
features.bifrost: none found (no annotation code in springboard/src/shell/books, springboard/sdk/src or springboard/apps/pdfcraft-desktop source)
features.note: pdfcraft-desktop is an upstream package with no source here, so its annotation support cannot be checked

features.apple: PDFAnnotation widget properties (widgetFieldType, widgetStringValue, text, button and choice widgets), form filling
features.note: The reader does not parse AcroForm fields

features.apple: PDFOutline: child(at:), label, destination, action, isOpen
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/books/engine/pdf/mod.rs:139-179 (outline() reads /Outlines into (title, page, level)); used at mod.rs:320 for the Books table of contents
features.note: Titles, page targets and levels are read for the Books TOC. No outline tree object, no actions, no editing

features.apple: PDFSelection, PDFDocument selection(from:at:to:at:with:), PDFPage selectionForWord(at:), selectionForLine(at:), PDFDocument find and FoundSelection
features.bifrost: none found in the Books reader (springboard/src/shell/books/engine/mod.rs and pdf/mod.rs have no search or selection code)
features.note: The shell has a general text search (springboard/sdk/src/quicksearch.rs), but it does not index PDF text. No selection object

features.apple: PDFDocument write operations, PDFDocumentWriteOption, accessPermissions, password unlock (takePasswordFrom)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/print.rs (Destination::Pdf copies the source file; no rewrite)
features.note: Save as PDF copies the original bytes, so no page edits are written. Encrypted and password-protected files are not handled

features.apple: NSPrintOperation with PDFDocument printing (PDFDocument drawing into print context)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/print.rs (PrintOperation::new(file).to(Destination::Printer(..)).run() submits with lp), docs/bifrost-ui.md:1322-1333 (Printing section)
features.note: The file is sent to CUPS as is. No page-level pagination, no print sheet, and no page range applied to PDF pages. Whether the Midget image ships CUPS is unchecked

gaps: No app-facing PDF document, page or view API in springboard/sdk/src (PDFDocument, PDFPage, PDFView have no counterpart); the PDF reader is private to the Books app
No annotation, widget or form-field support (PDFAnnotation, AcroForm)
No page rendering into an app-provided context and no page thumbnails (PDFPage draw, PDFThumbnailView)
No text selection or find in PDFs (PDFSelection, PDFDocument find); the reader extracts text only
No write path: Save as PDF copies the original file, so page edits, rotation and password handling cannot be written
Printing sends the file to CUPS unchanged; there is no page-range or pagination handling for PDF content and no print sheet (see docs/bifrost-ui.md:1322-1333)
Outline is read into the Books table of contents only, with no outline tree object for apps
